caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and a single nori sheet. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a warm wooden table under soft, ambient light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows pinkish meat with white marbling, slightly curled edge, and glossy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
The miso broth is orange-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, with a slightly glossy, fibrous texture and irregular, segmented shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red and blue geometric pattern and Chinese characters along its rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
